description: SOURCE file containing the implementation of the 'Affiliate' class within the Opencart catalog mail controller namespace. The class handles email notifications related to affiliate activities such as registration and alerts.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class responsible for sending affiliate-related emails such as registration notifications and alerts within the OpenCart catalog module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the process of sending an affiliate registration email, including setting up email parameters, retrieving store info, and sending the email to the customer or specified email address.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Sends notification emails to admin and additional alert emails when a new affiliate registers or performs relevant actions, including fetching customer data and composing the email content.
